name: H2O-Lightning-4B

lineage.how_derived: decision model answering choice, yes/no (noul) and score questions about a record and its images

purpose: Typed decision questions about a record (document, ticket, policy, conversation) and accompanying images (photos, screenshots, scans, charts) with a probability per option (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (card tag)
license.notes: Card tag apache-2.0 and a LICENSE file in the repo; the text was not read.

pc-12gb.notes: 9.3 GB against a VRAM budget of 9.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-16gb.notes: 9.3 GB against a VRAM budget of 13.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-24gb.notes: 9.3 GB against a VRAM budget of 21.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-32gb.notes: 9.3 GB against a VRAM budget of 29.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

mac-16-24gb.notes: 9.3 GB against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 9.3 GB against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 9.3 GB against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

benchmarks.name: ImageJevBench v0.3.0 Composite rank among open-weight Jev-class models
benchmarks.variant: release v1.4.1, page read 2026-10-31; ahead of Drex Max 44.65, Jev 1.13.0 + images 26.43, Clef-Flash 20.41

strengths: A decision model reads a state (text, JSON, images) and a schema of typed questions and returns calibrated probabilities for every option in one forward pass; it does not generate text.
weaknesses: ranking claim comes from a benchmark edition different from the Decision Index boards, so it cannot be compared with them

tona_fit.reason: Small Apache 4B decision model with strong self-reported ranking on a different benchmark; same pipeline-step class as the other decision models.

open_questions: score on the Decision Index boards
